spec.name: sprint35_crypto_taker_imbalance_intraday
spec.hypothesis: Short-horizon taker buy/sell volume imbalance on BTCUSD/ETHUSD predicts next-15min directional drift, net of realistic crypto taker fees.
spec.power_argument: Prior alt-basket intraday sprints (32,34) showed per-trade net-return stdev ~80-110bps (backed out from reported mean/t/n). At n=320 (target), 80% power, alpha=0.05 two-sided => min detectable edge ~12-15bps, comfortably above assumed T2 round-trip cost (~5-10bps) and enough to distinguish real edge from noise -- unlike sprint33 which ran ZERO trades (powered=False, not a valid rejection).
